comment: Packets whose encoding differs from the BDS-derived schemas and which are reviewed and accepted. Anything NOT listed here fails the check. Every entry must say why the difference is acceptable and what would settle it; 'not investigated' is not a reason to add one.

packets.name: EditorNetwork
packets.reason: gophertunnel is very likely correct. It writes a bool then one NetworkLittleEndian NBT payload, and CloudburstMC does the same; the BDS dump appears to describe the payload's interior (a variant name and data) rather than its framing.

packets.name: StructureBlockUpdate
packets.reason: Unsettled optionality. gophertunnel writes both structure names unconditionally; the BDS dump marks the redacted name optional. Needs a packet capture.
